authority_note: Producer (orchestrator) never verifies; directive-compliance-verifier owns verification rows. All D-040 requirements bind the non-ledger sentinel D-040-BOOTSTRAP, so no per-task rows accrue here (D-038/D-039 precedent; validator c5 forbids sentinel task_ids in task_verifications). Independent verification of the executed unblocks is recorded as committed reports; tasks contracted UNDER this directive cite D-040:<requirement ids> and verify through their own DCV rows in the usual way.
